source.author: verg
source.text: At medias inter caedes exsultat Amazon, unum exserta latus pugnae, pharetrata Camilla, et nunc lenta manu spargens hastilia denset, nunc validam dextra rapit indefessa bipennem; aureus ex umero sonat arcus et arma Dianae.
source.text_original: At medias inter caedes exsultat Amazon, / unum exserta latus pugnae, pharetrata Camilla, / et nunc lenta manu spargens hastilia denset, / nunc validam dextra rapit indefessa bipennem; / aureus ex umero sonat arcus et arma Dianae.
source.text_english: Amid the slaughter the Amazon bounds forth, showing one side of her body in the fight, quivered Camilla, and now, with slow hand, scattering her spears, she thickens the ranks, now with her right hand, tirelessly, she snatches up the strong double-edged axe; the golden bow rings from her shoulder, and the arms of Diana.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: versam proles tua pandet Idumen namque potest : Solymo nigrantem pulvere fratrem spargentemque faces et in omni turre furentem.
reuse.text_original: versam proles tua pandet Idumen / (namque potest ): Solymo nigrantem pulvere fratrem / spargentemque faces et in omni turre furentem.
reuse.text_english: Your offspring will reveal Idumea turned over, for it can: the brother darkened with dust of Jerusalem, scattering torches and raging in every tower.
